ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides rising-edge timing used by pointer, write and read processes; sequences updates of pointers, memories and status outputs so stored values change on clock edges.
ports.evidence: Used in sensitivity lists and rising_edge checks in pointer_reg, write_*, async_r_pnt_reg, sync_read_large and sync_status processes.

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides asynchronous reset that clears pointers, storage and some outputs in reset branches; used to set initial values in clocked processes.
ports.evidence: Checked as 'if (rstn_i = '0')' in pointer_reg, write_reset_*, and sync_status processes.

ports.name: clear_i
ports.functionality: When asserted forces w_nxt and r_nxt to zero, overriding the increment paths so pointers will be cleared when captured on the next clock edge.
ports.evidence: Used in conditional assignments 'w_nxt <= (others => '0') when (clear_i = '1')' and similarly for r_nxt.

ports.name: half_o
ports.functionality: Exports the internal half signal to the outside; when FIFO_RSYNC is false it is driven combinationally, otherwise it is captured into the output on clock edges.
ports.evidence: Assigned 'half_o <= half' in async generate and set from half in sync_status process on rising_edge.

ports.name: level_o
ports.functionality: Provides a zero-extended 32-bit report of internal level; lower bits are copied from level and higher bits are zeroed so external logic sees the current fill level.
ports.evidence: level_extend process assigns level_o(level'left downto 0) <= level(level'left downto 0) and zeros the rest.

ports.name: wdata_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the input word that is written into the FIFO storage; when we is asserted the value is captured into fifo_reg or written into fifo_mem at the write pointer.
ports.evidence: Assigned to fifo_reg or fifo_mem in write_* processes when (we = '1').

ports.name: we_i
ports.functionality: Provides external write request which is converted into internal we (optionally masked by free when FIFO_SAFE) and thus controls pointer increment and memory writes.
ports.evidence: Processed in 'we <= we_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (we_i and free)'.

ports.name: free_o
ports.functionality: Exports the internal free signal to external logic; driven either combinationally or captured synchronously depending on FIFO_RSYNC.
ports.evidence: Assigned 'free_o <= free' in async generate and set in sync_status process on rising_edge.

ports.name: re_i
ports.functionality: Provides external read request which is converted into internal re (optionally masked by avail when FIFO_SAFE) and thus controls pointer increment and read sequencing.
ports.evidence: Processed in 're <= re_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (re_i and avail)'.

ports.name: rdata_o
ports.functionality: Delivers the FIFO output word read from storage: for depth=1 from fifo_reg, otherwise from fifo_mem indexed by r_pnt or r_pnt_ff; delivered either combinationally or on clock edge per FIFO_RSYNC.
ports.evidence: Assigned from fifo_reg or fifo_mem in fifo_read_async/fifo_read_sync generates and sync_read_large process.

ports.name: avail_o
ports.functionality: Exports the internal avail signal to external logic; driven combinationally or captured synchronously depending on FIFO_RSYNC to indicate that data is available to read.
ports.evidence: Assigned 'avail_o <= avail' in async generate and set in sync_status process on rising_edge.

signals.name: fifo_mem
signals.functionality: Holds the FIFO entries; on write it captures wdata_i at index from w_pnt on clock, and on read its indexed element is read to rdata_o.
signals.evidence: Assigned in write_large/write_reset_large processes 'fifo_mem(to_integer(unsigned(w_pnt(...)))) <= wdata_i' and read via 'rdata_o <= fifo_mem(...)'.

signals.name: fifo_reg
signals.functionality: When FIFO depth is 1 it captures wdata_i on write and supplies that exact vector to rdata_o on reads.
signals.evidence: Assigned in write_small/write_reset_small processes 'fifo_reg <= wdata_i' and used by 'rdata_o <= fifo_reg'.

signals.name: we
signals.functionality: Derived from we_i (and masked by free when FIFO_SAFE) and enables writes into storage and pointer increment when asserted.
signals.evidence: Computed 'we <= we_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (we_i and free)' and tested in 'if (we = '1')' in write_* processes and w_nxt assignment.

signals.name: re
signals.functionality: Derived from re_i (and masked by avail when FIFO_SAFE) and controls pointer increment for reads by enabling r_nxt to advance.
signals.evidence: Computed 're <= re_i when (FIFO_SAFE = false) else (re_i and avail)' and used in r_nxt conditional expression.

signals.name: match
signals.functionality: Signals whether read and write pointer low bits match; computed from r_pnt and w_pnt and used to determine full and empty conditions.
signals.evidence: Assigned 'match <= '1' when (r_pnt(...)=w_pnt(...)) else '0'' and used in full/empty definitions.

signals.name: empty
signals.functionality: Derived from pointer relation and match; indicates FIFO empty and is used to drive avail (avail <= not empty).
signals.evidence: Computed 'empty <= '1' when (r_pnt(...) = w_pnt(...)) and (match = '1')' and avail <= not empty.

signals.name: full
signals.functionality: Derived from pointer relation (and match) to indicate FIFO full; used to compute free (free <= not full) and contributes to half calculation.
signals.evidence: Assigned 'full <= '1' when (...) and (match = '1')' or 'full <= not match' and used in 'free <= not full' and half computation.

signals.name: half
signals.functionality: Combines level MSB and full to indicate half/full threshold; its value is exported to half_o.
signals.evidence: Assigned 'half <= level(level'left-1) or full' (or 'half <= full' for depth=1) and used to drive half_o.

signals.name: free
signals.functionality: Is the inversion of full and is used to mask writes when FIFO_SAFE is true and to drive the free_o output.
signals.evidence: Assigned 'free <= not full' and used in 'we <= ... (we_i and free)' and 'free_o <= free'.

signals.name: avail
signals.functionality: Is the inversion of empty and is used to mask reads when FIFO_SAFE is true and to drive the avail_o output.
signals.evidence: Assigned 'avail <= not empty' and used in 're <= ... (re_i and avail)' and 'avail_o <= avail'.

signals.name: w_pnt
signals.functionality: Captures w_nxt on the clock edge; its value is used combinationally to index fifo_mem, compute level, match, full and empty decisions.
signals.evidence: Updated 'w_pnt <= w_nxt' in pointer_reg; used in w_nxt expression, match/full/empty/level calculations and as index in fifo_mem write.

signals.name: w_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinationally computes the next write pointer: zeroed by clear_i, incremented when we, otherwise holds w_pnt; w_pnt then captures this on clock.
signals.evidence: Assigned 'w_nxt <= (others => '0') when (clear_i = '1') else ... when (we = '1') else w_pnt'.

signals.name: r_pnt
signals.functionality: Captures r_nxt on the clock edge; its value is used combinationally to index fifo_mem for reads and to compute level, match, full and empty.
signals.evidence: Updated 'r_pnt <= r_nxt' in pointer_reg; used in r_nxt, match/full/empty/level calculations and as index in fifo_mem read.

signals.name: r_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinationally computes the next read pointer: zeroed by clear_i, incremented when re, otherwise holds r_pnt; r_pnt captures this on clock.
signals.evidence: Assigned 'r_nxt <= (others => '0') when (clear_i = '1') else ... when (re = '1') else r_pnt'.

signals.name: r_pnt_ff
signals.functionality: When FIFO_RSYNC is false captures r_nxt on the clock to provide a stable read pointer used to index fifo_mem for combinational rdata_o reads.
role: holds read pointer for async reads
signals.evidence: Updated in async_r_pnt_reg process 'r_pnt_ff <= r_nxt' and used as index in 'rdata_o <= fifo_mem(to_integer(unsigned(r_pnt_ff(...))))'.

signals.name: level
signals.functionality: Holds the computed difference unsigned(w_pnt)-unsigned(r_pnt); lower bits are forwarded to level_o and a top bit slice contributes to half computation.
signals.evidence: Assigned 'level <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(w_pnt) - unsigned(r_pnt))' and used in level_extend and half assignment ('level(level'left-1)').
